newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Falcon estimate lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Falcon estimate lowered.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Tuesday it lowered its earnings estimate for Falcon Products Inc to $1.04 a share from $1.05 to reflect slightly lower-than-anticipated earnings for the first quarter of 1997.
-- Falcon reported earnings of $0.19 a share, versus $0.17 in the first quarter of 1996, slightly below EVEREN's estimate of $0.20 a share for the period.
-- EVEREN said there is no change in its 1998 estimate of $1.24 a share.
-- Falcon makes and markets furniture for national restaurant chains in addition to hotel and office markets.
-- Its shares were up 3/4 Tuesday at 15-3/4.
